notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi humans,

We've just released update 1.1.1 for "They Came for More Pasta".

Here are the changes included in this patch:


 Added Korean language support.
 Fixed a dialogue issue that could occur during delivery in the woods.
 Fixed a camera issue that could occur when moving through spaceship corridors.


Thanks for playing!

We appreciate your feedback! If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam.
